desc: Assistant shows it is using Inkling 2 Mini via OpenRouter
Model answer is shown with the approved source it used
Student can check the approved text behind the AI answer
Only the question and approved entries are sent (no student records)
Policy question never reaches the model and goes to the coordinator
Question about another student never reaches the model (privacy rule)
Answer citing an entry we did not send is turned into a handoff
Model handoff goes to the coordinator queue with its reason
If the model fails, the approved retrieval answer is shown and labelled
No JavaScript errors during the run
